name: Trample: full aura and one stun bonus
targetName: one full Trample aura and empowered-attack magic bonus
objective: Investigate high one full Trample aura and empowered-attack magic bonus output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
mechanic: The aura deals 80/110/140/170/200 + 0.7 AP magic over five seconds, not per tick. Champion-damaging pulses build five stacks, enabling one next-attack magic bonus from a level-breakpoint helper. That attack bonus has no direct AP coefficient in the extracted helper; the ordinary physical attack is separate.
finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy champion: 10000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 6s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop damage at death, cap observed healing at recipient missing HP, and report raw output separately. Seraph transformed and Riftmaker legally pre-ramped. One surviving champion stays inside for the full five seconds; five stacks are actually earned. Deliver exactly one empowered champion attack before its state expires, inside a six-second observation. No Q/W, ordinary attack damage or extra victims in the selected result.
test: Count aura ticks, stack gain and one stun bonus separately. Compare AP versus penetration swaps; test leaving the aura early and missing the five-stack condition. Measure the ordinary attack outside the E magic total.
limits: No five copies of the displayed full-duration aura, AP scaling invented on the stun bonus, attack crit applied to magic packets, or a free empowered hit without five earned stacks. A partial aura and a full aura require different totals.
tradeoff: Five seconds in close range and a final attack can be hard to maintain with a fragile AP inventory.

Their nominal sum is 675 + 1.5 AP + 0.02 maximum mana if both legally occur. Shield destruction is utility, not additional health damage, and ordinary attack damage is outside this R-only result.
